newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: CREDIT SUISSE DETAILS ESTIMATED EARNINGS.
newsitem.headline: CREDIT SUISSE DETAILS ESTIMATED EARNINGS.

text.p: WINTERTHUR, Switzerland, Aug 11 - Credit Suisse Group (CSG)said the combined group net profit of the bank Winterthur Group was estimated by analysts at 3.020 billion Swiss francs in 1997 and would grow to 3.486 billion in 1998.
In a joint statement, the two companies provided a table over the estimated earnings of CSG and Winterthur, based on "selected analyst consensus earnings estimates."
The table shows estimated 1997 CSG 1997 net profit of 2.4 billion and Winterthur net profit of 620 million. In 1998 CSG's profit was estimated at 2.660 billion and Winterthur's at 730 million.
In 1998 post-tax synergies of the merger would amount to 96 million francs.
The original estimated 1997 earnings per share (EPS) was 12.3 francs and the pro-forma EPS would fall to 11.4 francs.
In 1998 the original estimated EPS was 13.6 francs and that would then fall to 13.1 francs.
